patch.objective: Use policy engines and admission controllers for governance: Kyverno and OPA Gatekeeper policies, ValidatingAdmissionPolicy, and exceptions

sources.cite: CNCF Certified Cloud Native Platform Engineer (CNPE) curriculum, as the course seed records it: Platform Architecture and Infrastructure 15%, GitOps and Continuous Delivery 25%, Platform APIs and Self-Service Capabilities 25%, Observability and Operations 20%, Security and Policy Enforcement 15%
sources.note: Weights and objective wording are the course seed's (backend/supabase/seed/tracks/cncf-ecosystem.ts). On 2026-11-17 a third-party page (golden-kubestronaut-learning.readthedocs.io/en/latest/cnpe, summarizing fetch) gave different domains (Platform Design 20%, Platform Implementation 30%, Platform Operations 25%, Security and Governance 15%, Developer Experience 10%) with 'GitOps implementation' under Platform Implementation. Which is current is not settled here: to verify against the official curriculum (finding for the verification pass).

sources.cite: Kyverno documentation (release 1.13), Policy Reports: Background Scans
sources.note: Read through a summarizing fetch on 2026-11-17. Relevant text: background scans validate 'existing resources in the cluster that may have been created before a policy was created', for validate and verifyImages rules; they run periodically, by default every hour; violations go to a PolicyReport or ClusterPolicyReport; background scanning is on by default and spec.background: false turns it off; results are reported whether failureAction is Audit or Enforce, and a scan 'does not block any existing resources that match a rule, even in Enforce mode'. The validate rules page (release 1.18) could not be read on 2026-11-17 (the fetch was not approved in time): the admission denial's wording and the per-rule failureAction field are from memory of Kyverno's documentation (to verify).
